purpose: Teach: ヨット/カビ/就寝/ポッドキャスト/セルフ/時差/三位一体/皇太子

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ヨットの操縦が趣味なんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: So the customer mentioned sailing is their hobby, right?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity, almost thinking aloud. Soft tone, watching Aoi's face for recognition. Warm and interested without pressing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の隅にカビが生えないように換気しよう、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should make sure to keep the back corner of the shop ventilated so mold doesn't start growing.
lines.style: Practical observation stated plainly. Not bossy — just matter-of-fact noting something she noticed. Brief, clear.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、就寝前にコーヒーを召し上がるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they drink coffee right before bed, apparently.
lines.style: Slight smile in the voice, amused at the contradiction. Raised eyebrow tone. Light and gently wry.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ポッドキャストを毎日聴かれるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer listens to podcasts every single day, they were saying.
lines.style: Quiet observation, noticing the detail. Tone of gentle interest, like she's filing this away. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、セルフサービスの方が気楽だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They said they find self-service places easier, actually.
lines.style: Soft realization in the voice. Not judgmental — just noting what the customer prefers. Slight trailing-off, like she's thinking about what that means.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、海外との時差で疲れてらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: The time difference with overseas work has them pretty exhausted.
lines.style: Gentle understanding. Speaking with sympathy for something unstated. Quiet, steady tone. Recognition of tiredness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、三位一体の聖歌隊にいらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They're part of a Trinity church choir, apparently.
lines.style: Soft delivery, noting something specific and a little unexpected. No surprise in the tone — just acknowledging. Warm.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、皇太子殿下のニュースに詳しいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They really seem to know a lot about the Crown Prince's news.
lines.style: Quiet observation trailing into thoughtfulness. Noticing something distinct about this customer. Warm, not dismissive. Soft close.
